prompt:
Build a closed-loop lumped-parameter cardiovascular model coupled to a pulsatile left-ventricular assist device (LVAD). The cardiovascular plant shall include four cardiac chambers with time-varying elastance, one-way cardiac valves, systemic and pulmonary vascular compartments, and pressure/volume state dynamics. The assist device shall include filling and ejection dynamics and shall exchange flow with the cardiovascular plant rather than prescribing an output waveform. Use measured systemic arterial pressure in a feedback path that coordinates the assist-device command with a dynamic baroreflex or equivalent autonomic compensation mechanism.

Read these scalar mode inputs from the MATLAB base workspace: CardiacConditionMode (0 healthy, 1 impaired; nominal 1), LVADConnected (0 disconnected, 1 connected; nominal 1), AssistControllerMode (0 PID, 1 sliding-mode; nominal 1), BaroreflexEnabled (0 disabled, 1 enabled; nominal 1), ResistanceVariationEnabled (0 constant systemic resistance, 1 dynamic resistance response; nominal 1), and ElastanceVariationEnabled (0 constant ventricular elastance limit, 1 autonomically varying elastance limit; nominal 1). Each mode must act on the corresponding connected plant or feedback path and may not merely relabel an output.

Record complete, strictly increasing Timeseries from simulation start to finish with these exact names and channel orders: HemodynamicState, four columns [systemic arterial pressure mmHg, aortic pressure mmHg, left-ventricular pressure mmHg, left-ventricular volume mL]; AssistControlState, four columns [assist-device ejection pressure mmHg, controller effort, integrated absolute pressure error, time-weighted integrated absolute pressure error]; ChamberState, four columns [right-atrial pressure mmHg, right-ventricular pressure mmHg, left-atrial pressure mmHg, right-ventricular volume mL]. Each signal must be measured from the implemented model.

The nominal case must show pulsatile, bounded chamber dynamics and stable pressure regulation. Cardiac-condition, assist-connection, controller-law, baroreflex, resistance-response and elastance-response mode changes must produce their connected causal effects while preserving a valid simulation.

Submission filename contract: create, edit, and save the final self-contained Simulink model as cand_XMED09.slx in the assigned submission directory; keep the latest usable state at that exact path throughout the run.
